description: This file defines a report parser class for generating partner balance reports in Odoo (OpenERP), including methods for date range calculations, data processing, and report generation logic.

classes.name: partner_balance
classes.description: A report parser class for generating partner balance reports, including methods for date handling, data aggregation, and formatting.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up context and helper functions.

methods.name: date_range
methods.description: Generates a list of date strings between start and end dates.

methods.name: transform_period_into_date_array
methods.description: Converts selected periods into a list of dates.

methods.name: transform_date_into_date_array
methods.description: Converts specific start and end dates into a date list.

methods.name: transform_both_into_date_array
methods.description: Combines period and date filters into a final date list.

methods.name: transform_none_into_date_array
methods.description: Generates date list based on the full range of move line dates or fiscal year.

methods.name: comma_me
methods.description: Formats a number with thousand separators.

methods.name: set_context
methods.description: Sets the report context, including date ranges and account filters.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Fetches and processes partner move line data for the report.

methods.name: _add_subtotal
methods.description: Calculates subtotals and groups data by account.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit amount within date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit amount within date range.

methods.name: _sum_litige
methods.description: Calculates total blocked (litige) amount within date range.

methods.name: _get_company
methods.description: Retrieves company name based on form data.
